title: Continue structured approval across every portfolio batch
description:
As a portfolio operator, I want every ready target batch to receive an independent structured review, so that portfolios larger than five targets neither skip decisions nor stop after the first batch.

Feature: Multi-batch optimization approval continuation

Scenario: More than five targets require approval
  Given a portfolio has more than five optimization-ready targets
  When the procedure requests structured approval
  Then it presents no more than five exact targets at a time
  And after one batch is resolved it requests the next unresolved batch
  And it dispatches nothing until every batch has a valid independent decision

Scenario: Procedure replay
  Given one approval batch was resolved before a human wait checkpoint
  When the procedure resumes for a later batch
  Then the earlier response remains bound to its original evidence
  And the earlier batch is not requested or dispatched twice.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Outside-in proof complete: the new six-target specification first showed both batches remaining pending after the first decision. The procedure now persists evidence-bound responses across checkpoints, requests only the next unresolved batch of at most five, and dispatches nothing until every batch is resolved. Focused regression is green.
